create_debug_session: create a DebugSession instance to record tool calls to a JSON log file when debug mode is enabled
test_debug_session_active: test the DebugSession.active property to check if debug logging is currently enabled
test_debug_session_log_call: test the DebugSession.log_call method to append a tool-call entry with name and data to the in-memory log
refactor_debug_session_save: refactor the DebugSession.save method to flush the in-memory call log to a timestamped JSON file in the logs directory
summarize_debug_session_info: summarize the DebugSession.get_session_info method to return a summary dict with session ID, log path, and call count
